title: J&K Consumer Commission Holds J&K Bank Liable For Crediting FDR Proceeds To Third Party Without Valid Mandate
description: The Jammu & Kashmir State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Jammu, comprising President (O) Smt. Nighat Sultana and Member Sh. Maheep Gupta, held Jammu & Kashmir Bank guilty of deficiency in service for unauthorisedly crediting the maturity proceeds of the complainant's Fixed Deposit Receipts (FDRs) to a third-party account without a valid mandate.
